subject: Solacea: expansion to additional teams, API keys & term adjustment
messages:
From: Alex Wang <alex.wang@solacea.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@solacea.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Solacea expansion request: additional teams & term question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We want to move forward with adding three additional engineering teams (search, billing, and platform integrations) to our existing deployment. Rough asks: 12 additional API keys (one per team + sandbox keys), bumped burst capacity during rollout, and clarification on how an expanded committed capacity would affect our current term and pricing.

Quick operational notes: the platform team needs a separate namespace for service accounts and we'd like to stagger the keys over two sprints to avoid a one-day cutover.

Can you outline next steps and any documents you need from us (PO, updated SOW, security attestations)?

Best,
Alex
Alex Wang
Head of Platform Engineering, Solacea AI
---
Solacea AI (external)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@solacea.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@solacea.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solacea expansion request: additional teams & term question

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answer: we can support the additional teams and separate namespaces; we'll propose a staged rollout and an adjusted committed capacity that preserves your unit economics. Next steps from our side:

- Sales/Commercial will draft a short addendum with updated quantities and term options (Ben).
- Ops/CS will produce a rollout checklist and namespace/key naming conventions (Laura).
- Legal will confirm if the requested capacity change requires a formal SOW amendment or if an addendum suffices (Markus).

Operationally, please confirm: desired go-live window (two-week window preferred), whether sandbox keys must be separated into a different billing view, and any SSO/SCIM needs for the new service accounts.

I'll loop the right folks and circulate a proposed timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@solacea.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@solacea.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solacea expansion request: additional teams & term question

Alex / team —

Thanks — I ran preliminary math based on the 3-team expansion and the burst capacity request. High level:

- Proposal: add 12 production keys + 4 sandbox keys, staged over two sprints.
- Committed capacity: increase existing committed tokens by ~45% to keep per-token pricing stable; alternative is a blended rate for the added capacity if you prefer not to change the baseline commit.
- Term options: 12-month addendum (minimal uplift) or 24-month extension with deeper discounts and a one-time credit for migration support.

I attached a workbook with line-level quantities and an updated proposal PDF (redwood-proposal-v2.pdf) — this is a starting point, not final. If you want a one-pager we can convert to customer-facing SOW language.

Deal id proposal: SOLA-2027-004 (provisional).

If helpful, we can schedule a quick pricing walkthrough with finance tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Solacea_MAAP_Qty.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@solacea.ai>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@solacea.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solacea expansion request: additional teams & term question

Alex / Priya —

Following internal alignment, here is an operational rollout plan to make the expansion low-friction:

1) Pre-rollout (week 0)
   - Confirm final list of teams + owners (you)
   - Sign addendum (sales) and PO if required
   - Confirm namespace naming convention and sandbox separation (example: solacea-prod-search, solacea-sanbox-search)

2) Sprint A (week 1) — Search & Billing teams
   - Provision 6 keys (4 prod, 2 sandbox)
   - Run smoke tests against a staging endpoint
   - Enable burst policy for first 72 hours

3) Sprint B (week 3) — Platform integrations
   - Provision remaining keys
   - Coordinate with your infra for SCIM/SSO and network allowlists
   - Post-migration review and key rotation schedule

Technical checklist (short): API namespaces created, key-labels added, allowlists updated, monitoring hooks (Datadog/Rollbar) configured, quota alerts set.

I created a short checklist in our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-solacea-mamap — please grant Laura.Bennett@redwood.com edit rights if you want us to manage the checklist directly.

If you confirm the go-live window (we penciled Mon 2027-08-02 for Sprint A), we'll start provisioning staging keys by next Monday. Also flagged to Markus for the contract language; he will confirm if we need an SOW.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: migrated-api-namespace-checklist.md
